data_source: reuse current ALDEBARAN fixtures, logos, markets and bet-slip state
render_demo_account: current demo auth/session; keep current balance; never copy reference account

ids.selection: market + outcome; same across left and right

counts.sport: derive from actual filtered fixtures; no hard-coded reference 55
counts.additional_markets: count available market groups in selected fixture model

events.inspect_different_match: preserve list scroll; update detail; reset only detail scroll; keep slip
events.toggle_odds: existing single slip action; no scroll reset; reflect both panels
events.filter_change: retain selected fixture if visible; otherwise select first result; empty list clears detail
events.slip_keep: use existing persistence mechanism and ALDEBARAN namespace
events.delete_all: clear current slip via existing handler
events.quick_amount: use existing max/balance policy; format thousands separators

destinations.existing_feature: reuse actual in-app destination or modal
destinations.sports_modes: use current fixtures and selected category; domestic/european/inplay filter changes must be real
destinations.casino_slots: existing local preview/lobby if available; otherwise content-filled modal with existing category images and at least representative item cards
destinations.notice_event: title/date/list/detail demo records, not one-line preparing message
destinations.attendance: local monthly calendar and visibly persisted daily check-in state
destinations.support: local inquiry form/view and support information; no fabricated external contact
destinations.rules: readable sectioned demo terms/help content; no external submission
destinations.community: local sample post list with readable detail
destinations.results: finished fixtures scoreboard from same data
destinations.deposit_withdraw_payback_bonus: existing demo modal/state or locally scoped demo explanation/form; no new payment or transfer API
destinations.messages_history: local demo messages and existing demo selections/history
destinations.anonymous_join: local demo account flow; no real identity collection
destinations.banner_support_channel: configured approved URL if one exists; otherwise local support/notice view

verification: one existing build plus a few changed flows; no QA thread or Jev
